specification: the internal test-harness specification of 14 Nov 2026, revision 3 (final)

model.weights_dtype: fp8 e4m3, 128x128 blocks (the published FP8 checkpoint)
model.layers: 64: 48 Gated DeltaNet (48 value heads over 16 key heads, 128x128 state per head) + 16 attention (24 heads, 4 KV heads x 256)
model.storage: HF_HUB_CACHE=/data/hf/hub on the 100 GB volume; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 in every job

engine.name: sglang
engine.build_facts: runbook/manifest.sh output in every run manifest (source, library and package hashes)

hardware.allocation: 1 x NVIDIA H100 PCIe 80 GB, host quick-einstein (28 CPUs, 177 GB RAM), driver 580, CUDA 13
hardware.label: H100 port evaluated with paper-inspired methodology (the paper used B200, RTX PRO 6000 and RTX 5090)

numerical_policy.folds: staggered by default (LEAPQUANT_FOLD_POLICY unset = stagger; 'aligned' gives the earlier default)
numerical_policy.owner: Asif (changes create a new numerical candidate and need new quality evidence)
numerical_policy.changed: 15 Nov 2026, 05:00 UTC, Asif: one sweep (B52) and staggered folds (B53) adopted; runs before this used 2 sweeps and aligned/auto folds

objective.primary: successful deployment output tokens/s per allocated GPU of the combined LeapQuant candidate (lq_combined) at its best SLO-eligible operating point, against the fastest quality-qualified comparable control, on infx_fixed_seq 1k/1k and 8k/1k and aa_slt_local; and USD per million successful output tokens on the same boundary
always_visible: output TPS per all allocated GPUs
USD per million successful output tokens
the same three restricted to SLO-qualified requests

eligibility.quality: candidate-level: noninferior to the FP32 reference on every qualification task at the 1-point margin (docs/DECISIONS.md); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL and no quality-qualified cost claim
eligibility.reliability: error rate <= 1% of attempted measured requests (slo-interactive-v1 global constraint)
eligibility.latency: slo-interactive-v1 (TTFT <= 2 s and TPOT <= 50 ms together, per request); slo-batch-v1 reported alongside for 8k/1k

objective.smallest_economically_useful_effect: 3% more successful output tokens/s at equal cost per hour (cost ratio 0.971)
objective.confidence_interval_target: 95% interval half-width on the paired log ratio <= 1.5% (to resolve a 3-4% effect)
objective.headline_estimator: geometric mean of per-block paired ratios, t interval on log ratios
objective.frozen: these fields are frozen before the confirmation dataset; v6 targets kept in history

history_v6_targets.plan5_G3_kernel: <= 0.306 ms per token at batch 512 (20% below bf16 window 0.382 ms); met 14 Nov 13:08 with 0.3004 ms (results/g3-final, component-sum method)
history_v6_targets.v6_gates: G0 Evidence, G1 Numerical, G2 Kernel, G3 State, G4 Product, G5 Release (harness/config/gates.json)

comparison_classes.same_capacity: same admissible active requests (max running 512), same configured slots (1,100) and cache budgets; isolates implementation changes
comparison_classes.equal_total_memory: different slot counts, all allocations charged to one GPU-byte budget (measured, not configured)
comparison_classes.best_qualified: each arm at its best tuned configuration, quality-qualified; assesses the product

primary_cells: infx_fixed_seq:infx_1k1k at the selected operating point
infx_fixed_seq:infx_8k1k at the selected operating point

repetition_design.unit: independent paired run block (server restart per arm and block, balanced order)
repetition_design.pilot: pilot_128_512_c512: 5 paired blocks to learn the run-to-run variance
repetition_design.confirmation: sample size frozen from the pilot before any confirmation result is seen: n = max(5, lqh.stats.required_blocks(pilot sd of log ratios, 0.015)), capped at 12 blocks per primary cell; screening data never counted as confirmation
repetition_design.inconclusive_outcome: an interval that cannot exclude the smallest useful effect is reported as INCONCLUSIVE; no extra blocks beyond the frozen n
repetition_design.selection_disclosure: the operating point chosen from screening is confirmed on new blocks; the number of screened cells is published

plateau_rule_aa_slt: stop when two successive +64 steps each add < 3% steady output throughput, a point exceeds 5% errors, or the plan budget is used (local rule, not AA's)

budget.note: plans stop starting new arms when their budget_s is used; skipped cells are recorded as not_run with the reason

arms: leapquant (lq_final: staggered folds, fused slot copy, one sweep)

tasks.gpqa_diamond: Idavidrein/gpqa gpqa_diamond (198 questions): BLOCKED until the HF account accepts the dataset terms
tasks.livecodebench_v6: livecodebench/code_generation_lite release_v6: BLOCKED until a sandboxed scorer exists (private tests are pickled; executing model code needs isolation)

sampling.not_reproduced: the paper's early stop on repetitive output (method not published)
sampling.max_output_tokens_note: raised from the paper's 81,920 (Table 5) by Asif on 15 Nov 2026, before any run of this qualification: at 81,920, 11-12% of answers were cut in the strict paper lane (target under 5%). A deviation from the paper.
sampling.seeds_note: 12-hour schedule: one seed per question (3 seeds deferred)

quality_qualification.answer_budget_rule: fewer than 5% of answers cut at the budget; the cap rate is reported per arm and task; capped answers count as wrong in the fixed-budget primary outcome
quality_qualification.concurrency: retraction-free (backlog B58): min(16, KV tokens / (prompt budget 1,536 + 131,072)) per arm, radix cache off, SGLang static memory 0.90 (KV pool ~1.71M tokens): 12 requests per arm. 0 retractions checked per arm.
quality_qualification.join: paired by sample ID and seed; question-clustered interval (eval/accuracy_bench.py), Newcombe hybrid interval for single-sample pairs (no degenerate zero-discordance interval)
quality_qualification.decision_rule_frozen: If bf16_window is noninferior to FP32 at the 1-point margin on EVERY task, it stays the primary product baseline. Otherwise (FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or a task not run) it is ineligible as the primary baseline: its speed stays visible and FP32 is the comparator for cost claims. LeapQuant gets a quality-qualified cost claim only if it is noninferior on every task.
quality_qualification.paper_bf16_variant: rounded every decode step ('per-step', paper Table 1/2); the windowed BF16 appears only in the paper's ablation (Table 2: 87.8 AIME 2026)
arms_deferred: bf16_rounded (the paper's BF16 baseline): not run in the 12-hour schedule

subsets_12h.gpqa_diamond: 30 of 198 (evenly spaced), if the dataset terms are accepted
subsets_12h.livecodebench_v6: 12 problems (evenly spaced) of the paper's window, if the sandboxed scorer passes its self-test
subsets_12h.power: one seed and these subsets detect only large losses (interval half-widths of roughly 10-25 points); the frozen 1-point rule cannot pass at this size, so every task is expected INCONCLUSIVE. The full qualification (3 seeds, all questions, 4 arms) needs about 60 GPU-hours.

order_of_work.what: time the complete, state-advancing layer cycle with the CUDA fold on one build, with its log
qualify the 16-bit window control on the paper's tasks
total GPU bytes for every arm, with configured slots, running and waiting requests printed
paired pilot of 128/512 at concurrency 512, five blocks

validation_pair_q38.purpose: Qwen3.8-27B: one real baseline/candidate pair on all three lanes (harness sanity before the matrix)

points.note: validation only: 60 s steady phase (AA uses 180 s)

matrix_infx_q38.purpose: Qwen3.8-27B: InferenceX fixed-sequence sweep (pinned client), screening block, same grid as the 9B
matrix_infx_q38.order_note: one block: the product candidate first, so a budget stop can only drop the last arm (the job's own timeout is the hard stop)

matrix_aa_slt_q38.purpose: Qwen3.8-27B: AA-SLT method sweep at 1-512 users (1,024 dropped: every arm saturates far below it), screening block
matrix_aa_slt_q38.order_note: one block: the product candidate first, so a budget stop can only drop the last arm (the job's own timeout is the hard stop)

confirm_aa_slt_q38.purpose: Qwen3.8-27B: confirmation repeats, AA-SLT at 1, 64, 256, 512 users, three arms in every block, 5 paired blocks
confirm_aa_slt_q38.order_note: baseline lq_final_q38: the report gives bf16_window_q38 / lq_final_q38 and fp32_packed_q38 / lq_final_q38

screen_aa_q38.purpose: Qwen3.8-27B screening inside the 15 Nov time box (multi-GPU benchmark prompt, stage 1: one-GPU short-context feasibility): AA-SLT method at 1, 16, 64 and 128 users, three arms with slots balanced for 1k/1k, one block. Screening, not confirmation: no interval.

second_model_note: Backlog B75 (Asif, 15 Nov 2026 ~22:00 UTC: 'proceed with Qwen 3.8 27B'): the newest released model with linear-attention layers that fits one H100. Arms use state slots balanced for 1k/1k from the first-contact probe (job 123, runbook/q38_probe.sh), not the 9B's counts (backlog B77).
